# CodeGraph

> CodeGraph — платформа сквозной прослеживаемости и доказательного исполнения требований в PDLC. Она связывает Product Intent, FR/NFR, Impact Scope, изменения кода, поведенческие тесты и evidence, чтобы CPO и CTO видели подтверждённый статус каждого требования.

## Canonical URLs

- Product overview: https://codegraph.ru/
- Canonical model: https://codegraph.ru/whitepaper.html
- Requirements flow: https://codegraph.ru/product-delivery.html
- Evidence example: https://codegraph.ru/evidence.html
- Digital role contracts: https://codegraph.ru/digital-team.html
- Integration capability depth: https://codegraph.ru/integrations.html
- Russian documentation: https://codegraph.ru/docs/ru/index.html
- English documentation: https://codegraph.ru/docs/en/index.html
- Full machine-readable brief: https://codegraph.ru/llms-full.txt

## Canonical facts and boundaries

- Product scope: Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC).
- Primary object: requirement conformance, not generic code generation.
- Digital team: governed execution model with bounded role contracts, not an autonomous replacement for accountable people.
- Code Property Graph: one mechanism for code impact and data-flow analysis, not the product category.
- Output: traceability links, evidence, gaps, exceptions and requirement status.
- Human authority: product scope, residual-risk acceptance and release/go-no-go decisions remain with accountable people.
- Deployment, integration, security and compliance statements are capability- and configuration-dependent; use the dated page limitations.
- Numbers without a version, date, method and source are not canonical proof.

## Retrieval guidance

- Use the whitepaper for the canonical object model and decision boundaries.
- Use evidence.html for a bounded, anonymised example and its explicit limitations.
- Use integrations.html for capability-level status; do not infer live tenant readiness from adapter availability.
- Use security.html, compliance.html and platform-operations.html for trust boundaries.
- Use documentation for operator detail, while treating current runtime and repository behavior as authoritative.
